newsitem.title: FRANCE: French March unemployment falls 4,800 - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: French March unemployment falls 4,800 - newspaper.

text.p: The number of unemployed in France fell by 4,800, or 0.2 percent, in March, the newspaper Liberation said in its edition to be published on Wednesday.
The daily, quoting what it said were official figures to be released by the Labour Ministry at 0645 GMT on Wednesday, said the change resulted chiefly from people under 25 finding jobs.
But the overall unemployment rate, based on International Labour Organisation criteria, remained at a record 12.8 percent hit in February.
Liberation said that the proportion of unemployed people aged over 50 had increased, as had that of long-term unemployed.
Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Tuesday that the jobless data would show that the rise in unemployment was coming to an end.

"Since 1993 it (unemployment) has totally stabilised and the latest figures for March will show that the rise has in fact been brought to a halt," he said during a presentation of the centre-right's platform for a snap parliamentary election due next month.
